versions.subject: fix: missing condition
versions.detection:
selection:
   Image|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
   CommandLine|contains: 'MSExchange'
   TargetFilename|contains:
      - 'FrontEnd\HttpProxy\'              # from GTSC and MSTI reports
      - '\inetpub\wwwroot\aspnet_client\'  # from GTSC report
selection_types:
   TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.aspx'
      - '.asp'
      - '.ashx'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\w3wp.exe" CommandLine="*MSExchange*" TargetFilename IN ("*FrontEnd\\HttpProxy\\*", "*\\inetpub\\wwwroot\\aspnet_client\\*") TargetFilename IN ("*.aspx", "*.asp", "*.ashx")
